title: Battle of Tendra
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tendra", at revision 1382487546, opens: "The Battle of Tendra was a naval action fought on 8 and 9 September 1790 in the Black Sea as part of the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792). It ended in a decisive victory for Ushakov's Russians over the Ottomans." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4438427, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1790 naval battle of the Russo-Turkish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
